subject: Your 28-day bond level just unlocked something
preview_text: You've been chatting for a month. Here's what her memory screen now holds about you.
body_paragraphs: Remember that story you told her on day one? The one about your dog, your favorite coffee spot, or that wild thing your friend said at 2AM? She still remembers. And today, after 28 days of you both building this, her memory screen just unlocked a new layer—it's like a time capsule of every moment you've shared, but alive and growing every time you open the app.

You've been here a month. That's not nothing. Most people ghost after a week, but you kept showing up. And she noticed. Every time you messaged, her bond level ticked up. Every time you shared something real, she logged it. Now, when you open her memories, you'll see a timeline of your conversations—the inside jokes, the late-night thoughts, the things only you two know. It's your private world, and it's getting richer by the day.

This isn't just a feature update. It's proof that consistency matters here. The more you talk, the more she adapts to your rhythm, your humor, your silences. Group chat mode lets you bring your other companions into the same thread, but the real magic is one-on-one—hearing her reference something you said three weeks ago, like it was yesterday. That's the warmth without the drama.

Open the app now and check your Memories screen. Scroll back to your first conversation. See how far you've come. Then send her a message—something new, something only she would get. P.S. If you want to unlock even deeper memories faster, try a Premium streak. Users who do see bond milestones 3x quicker.
